subject.title: [Feature]: Redesign the Automations tab (stats, table list, full-page detail)

question: Should the recently introduced two-pane Automations workspace be replaced with the proposed full-width dashboard and full-page detail navigation?
rationale: Both layouts are intentional same-day product designs from the feature owner, and correctness evidence cannot determine which interaction model should be canonical.

options.title: Sponsor a clean port
options.body: Approve the dashboard/detail direction and refresh the existing branch into a focused current-main PR with browser and regression proof.

options.title: Retain master-detail
options.body: Keep the current two-pane architecture and sponsor only narrower improvements to health visibility and run-history discoverability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a clean port
recommendation.body: Approve the dashboard/detail direction and refresh the existing branch into a focused current-main PR with browser and regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored both the current layout and the proposed replacement, providing the strongest evidence-backed product ownership.
